acme_prod_lead: Hey, our console shows tokens/sec going negative and TTFT spiking for org org_acme_42 around 09:20 UTC. Customers seeing latency + 500s on /v1/streams. Anyone able to triage?
gihan_support: Sorry — looking. Can you paste the org id + exact time range and any recent config/auth/billing changes?
acme_prod_lead: org_acme_42, window ~2026-03-16T09:20:00Z to 09:45:00Z. We rotated service key at ~09:15 and received billing email about card decline at 09:10. Server logs show some 401 errors then a bunch of 500s.
maria_oncall: Alert: streaming-metrics-rollup error spike. metrics-collector-bot shows negative delta emission starting 09:22. Snip from metrics node:```
[2026-03-16T09:22:03.214Z] ERROR rollup-aggregator: computed delta=-1245 for partition=3, window=2026-03-16T09:20:00Z
[2026-03-16T09:22:03.215Z] WARN consumer: offset reset triggered for group=k-consumer-42, partition=3 -> offset=0 (was 98765)
```
deploy-bot: config change deployed by ryan_eng_metrics at 2026-03-16T09:16:00Z: kafka.consumer.rebalance.strategy=sticky
ryan_eng_metrics: I flipped the rebalance strategy in the weekend patch to reduce churn. That alone shouldn't cause negatives but if a consumer restarts and resets offsets mid-window we can compute negative deltas (old offset > new offset). Quick repro I ran:```
# simulate consumer restart + offset reset
produce --topic=streaming-metrics --partition=3 --count=1000
stop-consumer --group=k-consumer-42
reset-offset --group=k-consumer-42 --partition=3 --to-earliest
start-consumer --group=k-consumer-42
# aggregator then sees previous high offset and new low offset -> negative delta emitted
```
gihan_support: Got it. Customer also reported 500s — could be related if aggregator or downstream dashboards error on negative metric values. Can you repro in staging?
ryan_eng_metrics: I can repro locally and in staging. Additional wrinkle: we saw expired credentials for the connector which cause the consumer to restart and in some cases an offset reset policy (billing auth caused 401 -> connector restart -> offset reset). Proposed short-term fix: clamp negative deltas to 0 in aggregation and emit a counter rollup.negative.count. Long-term: avoid reset-to-earliest on auth-related restarts, and improve checkpointing frequency.
metrics-collector-bot: job rollup/streaming-rollup failed: OffsetResetException partition=3 at 2026-03-16T09:22:02Z
judy_sre: We should backfill the affected windows for org_acme_42 and patch aggregator to avoid negative emissions. I'll coordinate backfill job. Also need a runbook update for connector restarts due to billing/auth.
acme_prod_lead: For our side, what repro steps should we run to validate once patched? Also please confirm if billing suspension caused the auth errors.
gihan_support: Repro steps for customer validation: 1) check billing webhook history for 'suspended' at ~09:10, 2) verify 401 spikes in auth logs 09:11-09:16, 3) check dashboard windows 09:20-09:30 for negative tokensec, 4) after hotfix confirm windows show zeros/backfilled values. We will open an official ticket and schedule backfill.
ryan_eng_metrics: Patch PR created: https://git.redwood/ryan/rollup-clamp - changes: clamp negative deltas to 0, add metric rollup.negative.count, bump checkpoint interval to 10s for streaming consumers. I'll push to canary after review.
maria_oncall: Deploying ryan's patch to canary now :rocket:. I'll monitor rollup.negative.count and token/sec windows.
acme_prod_lead: Thanks. Also, billing webhook shows a temporary 'suspended' at 09:11 due to card decline. That explains the 401s we saw. Can you confirm the timeline?
gihan_support: Confirmed — billing team webhook shows card_decline -> account suspended at 09:11, multiple 401s from clients 09:12-09:15, connector restarts 09:16, rollup negative emits 09:22. Root cause chain: billing -> auth failures -> connector restart/offset reset -> negative rollups + dashboard errors. We'll coordinate with billing to avoid auto-reset behaviours that cause metric corruption.
judy_sre: Action items: 1) Hotfix clamp negatives (in canary now), 2) Backfill windows and replay events for org_acme_42 (scheduled), 3) Update runbook to treat billing->auth restarts as special case, 4) Add alert on rollup.negative.count > 0. I'll assign owners and follow up in postmortem.
acme_prod_lead: Appreciate the quick action. Please keep us posted and share postmortem when done.
gihan_support: Opening ticket SUP-2026-17842, ETA: hotfix to canary within 30m, production rollout after verification (~2h), backfill complete ETA ~4h. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
